purpose: Small public style packet for agents that need to produce GBAutomation-branded frontend components, reports, decks, PDFs, SVGs, or image prompts.

glass-panel.purpose: Cream translucent panel with 12px backdrop blur and stone border.
glass-panel.css: background: rgba(230, 228, 217, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(214, 212, 200, 0.6); transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);

hover-shiny.purpose: Hover shine/border animation for cream cards and panels.
hover-shiny.requires: Set --shiny-bg to the panel background when not using #E6E4D9.
hover-shiny.animation: On hover, spins --gradient-angle through a terracotta conic-gradient border via border-spin 3s linear infinite.
hover-shiny.css_contract: Use linear-gradient(var(--shiny-bg), var(--shiny-bg)) padding-box plus conic-gradient(from var(--gradient-angle), transparent 20%, #D97757 50%, transparent 80%) border-box; border-color: transparent; transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px rgba(217,119,87,.15).
hover-shiny.accessibility: Disable or reduce animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

hover-mini.css: transition: all 0.2s ease-out; transform: translateY(-2px) on hover.

input-field.css: rgba(255,255,255,.4) background, stone border, ink text, terracotta focus border/outline.

reveal.purpose: Scroll/reveal state primitive controlled by adding .active.
reveal.css: opacity 0 and translateY(20px), then opacity 1 and translateY(0) when .active.

animate-marquee.purpose: Horizontal marquee track for tech/logo ribbons.
animate-marquee.css: marquee 30s linear infinite; pause on hover.

frontend_rules: Load get-gbauto-theme before specifying or implementing any GB-branded frontend or visual output.
Use Newsreader for headlines and Inter for body/UI.
Use cream-2 or glass-panel for card/panel surfaces.
Use terracotta for CTAs, highlights, glows, charts, badges, and selected states.
Use ink for text and primary CTA fills only. Do not use ink as card or panel background.
Use Tailwind arbitrary-value classes or CSS variables that match the canonical tokens exactly.
Reuse glass-panel, hover-shiny, hover-mini, and input-field where applicable.
Verify with a screenshot/browser/render check when practical.
For shine animation, use the documented hover-shiny conic-gradient border spin from /tac/style-primitives.css; do not invent blue/purple shimmer variants.
Reference public assets via /tac/assets.json; do not expose private client or second-brain asset paths.
forbidden: Generic Tailwind blues/grays as primary palette
JetBrains Mono, system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, or Roboto for branded output
Self-shipped theme.json files as the source of truth for brand validation

tailwind_examples.card: rounded-lg border border-[#D6D4C8] bg-[#E6E4D9] p-6 hover-shiny
tailwind_examples.primary_button: bg-[#191919] hover:bg-[#333] text-[#F3F1E7] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg hover-mini
tailwind_examples.terracotta_button: bg-[#D97757] hover:bg-[#B75F43] text-[#F3F1E7] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg hover-mini
tailwind_examples.shiny_card: glass-panel hover-shiny rounded-lg border border-[#D6D4C8] p-6 [--shiny-bg:#E6E4D9]

agent_instruction: When asked to design or review GBAutomation-branded UI, use this style packet as the public contract. If a task needs private TAC inventory, authenticated agent dispatch, or internal second-brain paths, stop and request the private TAC surface instead.
